title: herdr-app-tui mobile and desktop layout
brief: Mobile-first terminal UI for herdr-app-tui. On a phone the default face is the terminal with the top bar collapsed to one row; opening the panel is the deliberate act, shown in both faces here. On desktop the same panel is a narrow always-visible rail on the left, like an IDE sidebar. No status bar.

artboards.title: Command sheet
artboards.tradeoff: Lowest implementation risk and closest to today's overlay, but opening it hides the terminal entirely, so on a phone you cannot watch an agent while you pick the next one.

artboards.title: Rising sheet
artboards.tradeoff: One component serves phone and desktop and the terminal keeps nine live rows while the panel is open, but on a phone it competes with the keyboard and the terminal emulator's key bar for the lower half.

artboards.title: Peek header
artboards.tradeoff: Nothing is covered and the terminal stays interactive while the list is open, but expanding reflows and re-wraps the terminal, and the list is capped by the rows taken from the work area.
